run_get_stats: run a gRPC client to poll server-level statistics from a gRPC server using channelz
run_channelz_getservers: run a gRPC Channelz GetServers RPC call to retrieve all server metrics and statistics
create_grpc_insecure_channel: create an insecure gRPC channel to connect to a server address for polling statistics
create_channelz_stub: create a ChannelzStub instance from a gRPC channel to make channelz service calls
review_getservers_response: review the GetServers response containing server-level metrics like sent/received messages and RPC stats
